messages:
Priya: Idea: add a "Cost provenance" inspector in the Console. Click a heatmap cell -> see the chain: which prefetch/prefix produced credits, which routes consumed them, and a small sample of invocations showing the billed delta. Useful for hunting regressions where shared prefetches inflate marginal unit cost. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/prov/inspector.png :mag:

Priya: Interactions sketch: 1) open cell -> tile lists prefetch_ids with counts, 2) click a prefetch_id -> show sampled invocations (redacted), 3) run a "what-if" that estimates delta if that prefetch were disabled.

Hector: Strong yes. Two concerns: a) privacy - redact user text and only show hashed invocation ids, b) customers confuse "quota" vs "billing" when they see numbers. Add a badge "billing estimate" and a help link.

Lin: Telemetry additions: include `prefetch_id`, `prefetch_origin`, `kv_credit_tokens`, `route_choice`, `fallback_tag`, `sampled`, `sample_weight`. Keep event payload tiny; do heavy joins in batch.

Ravi: Rollup plan: stream raw events to raw_invocations. Daily job (ETL-502) computes per-route/model amortized_cost, marginal_cost_estimate, and builds a provenance_map: prefetch_id -> consuming_route -> uses. We'll persist tiles as JSON blobs keyed by date+route for fast Console fetch. SQL prototype:
```sql
SELECT prefetch_id, consuming_route, COUNT(*) as uses
FROM raw_invocations_sampled
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY prefetch_id, consuming_route;
```

Priya: Nice. For the "what-if" sim, keep it admin-only and rate-limited. We don't want orgs to accidentally blow ETL or confuse quotas. Add a small confidence score derived from `sample_weight` and effective_n.

Hector: And add a toggle in the UI: "Include cache credits" vs "Show raw spend". Also show p50/p95 token cost and standard error for the mean so teams know when cells are noisy.

Lin: Privacy: redact strings, only show safe fields. Also add an org-level opt-out for exposing sampled invocation lists. We'll reuse the existing gdpr_hash field.

Ravi: I'll schedule ETL-502 on MON/WED/FRI for alpha, use 1/20 sampling for cost reasons and keep `sample_weight` to unbiasedly scale. Job id infra/ETL-502.

ops-bot: console-service: feature flag `cost_provenance_alpha` enabled for orgs: redwood-internal, partner-sandbox. Canary rollout 5% traffic.

Priya: Great. I'll draft the tooltip copy and the short doc with formulas (amortized vs marginal vs raw) and link it from the UI. Target: internal alpha in ~10 days. Mockups coming in this channel. Thanks! :rocket:
